other_conditions: Unit must have its operations in Goa.
Applicant must be a Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership.
Bank accounts of the unit and/or its partners/directors must be linked to Aadhaar.
benefits_summary: 25% reimbursement on high‑speed bandwidth up to ₹5,00,000 per annum, payable for up to three years.
